newsitem.title: BARBADOS: Barbados to regulate stock market activity.
newsitem.headline: Barbados to regulate stock market activity.

text.p: The Barbados government plans to establish a regulatory agency to supervise activity in the local stock exchange, according to a government minister.
Industry and Business Development Minister Reginald Farley told the senate Wednesday the body would be similar in scope to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
The government was not satisfied that a self-regulating exchange was the best solution to protecting the integrity of the market and shareholders, he said.
A total of 19 companies now trade on the local stock exchange. Market capitalisation stands at about $1.4 billion.
